Document: Practice direction 49F: Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury Claims in Road Traffic Accidents and Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims – Stage 3 Procedure
Part 2 of 2
==================================================
## 7.2 Where the court considers that—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 7.2 Where the court considers that—] (1) further evidence must be provided by any party; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 7.2 Where the court considers that—] (2) the claim is not suitable to continue under the Stage 3 Procedure,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 7.2 Where the court considers that—] the court will order that the claim will continue under Part 7, allocate the claim to a track and give directions. ## 7.3 Where paragraph 7.2 applies the court will not allow the Stage 3 fixed costs. ## Acknowledgment of Service

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > Acknowledgment of Service] 8.1 The defendant must file and serve an acknowledgment of service in Form N210B not more than 14 days after service of the claim form. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > Acknowledgment of Service] 8.2 The defendant must file and serve with the acknowledgment of service, or as soon as possible thereafter, a certificate that is in force. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > Acknowledgment of Service] (‘Certificate’ is defined in rule 36.15(1)(e)(i).)

## 8.3 The acknowledgment of service must state whether the defendant—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 8.3 The acknowledgment of service must state whether the defendant—] (1) (a) contests the amount of damages claimed;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 8.3 The acknowledgment of service must state whether the defendant—] (b) contests the making of an order for damages;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 8.3 The acknowledgment of service must state whether the defendant—] (c) disputes the court’s jurisdiction; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 8.3 The acknowledgment of service must state whether the defendant—] (d) objects to the use of the Stage 3 Procedure;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 8.3 The acknowledgment of service must state whether the defendant—] (2) wants the claim to be determined by the court on the papers or at a Stage 3 hearing. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 8.3 The acknowledgment of service must state whether the defendant—] 8.4 Where the defendant objects to the use of the Stage 3 Procedure reasons must be given in the acknowledgment of service. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 8.3 The acknowledgment of service must state whether the defendant—] 8.5 The acknowledgment of service may be signed and filed by the defendant’s insurer who may give their address as the address for service. ## Dismissal of the claim

## 9.1 Where the defendant opposes the claim because the claimant has—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 9.1 Where the defendant opposes the claim because the claimant has—] (1) not followed the procedure set out in the relevant Protocol; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 9.1 Where the defendant opposes the claim because the claimant has—] (2) filed and served additional or new evidence with the claim form that had not been provided under the relevant Protocol,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 9.1 Where the defendant opposes the claim because the claimant has—] the court will dismiss the claim and the claimant may start proceedings under Part 7. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 9.1 Where the defendant opposes the claim because the claimant has—] (Rule 45.35 sets out the costs consequences of failing to comply with the relevant Protocol.)

## Withdrawal of the Protocol offer

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > Withdrawal of the Protocol offer] 10.1 A party may only withdraw a Protocol offer after proceedings have started with the court’s permission. Where the court gives permission the claim will no longer continue under the Stage 3 Procedure and the court will give directions. The court will only give permission where there is good reason for the claim not to continue under the Stage 3 Procedure. ## Consideration of the claim

## 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] (1) on the papers; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] (2) at a Stage 3 hearing where—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] (a) the claimant so requests on the claim form;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] (b) the defendant so requests in the acknowledgment of service (Form N210B); or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] (c) the court so orders,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] and on a date determined by the court. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] 11.2 The court will give the parties at least 21 days notice of the date of the determination on the papers or the date of the Stage 3 hearing. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] 11.3 Where further deductible amounts have accrued since the final offer was made by both parties in the Court Proceedings Pack (Part B) Form, the defendant must file an up to date certificate at least 5 days before the date of a determination on the papers. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] 11.4 Where the claim is determined on the papers the court will give reasons for its decision in the judgment. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 11.1 The court will order that damages are to be assessed—] (‘Deductible amount’ is defined in rule 36.15(1)(d).)

## Settlement at Stage 2 where the claimant is a child

## 12.1 Paragraphs 12.2 to 12.5 apply where—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 12.1 Paragraphs 12.2 to 12.5 apply where—] (1) the claimant is a child;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 12.1 Paragraphs 12.2 to 12.5 apply where—] (2) there is a settlement at Stage 2 of the Protocol; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 12.1 Paragraphs 12.2 to 12.5 apply where—] (3) an application is made to the court to approve the settlement. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 12.1 Paragraphs 12.2 to 12.5 apply where—] 12.2 Where the settlement is approved at the settlement hearing the court will order the costs to be paid in accordance with rule 45.31(2). [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 12.1 Paragraphs 12.2 to 12.5 apply where—] 12.3 Where the settlement is not approved at the first settlement hearing and the court orders a second settlement hearing at which the settlement is approved, the court will order the costs to be paid in accordance with rule 45.31(4) to (6). [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 12.1 Paragraphs 12.2 to 12.5 apply where—] 12.4 Where the settlement is not approved at the first settlement hearing and the court orders that the claim is not suitable to be determined under the Stage 3 Procedure, the court will order costs to be paid in accordance with rule 45.32 and will give directions. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 12.1 Paragraphs 12.2 to 12.5 apply where—] 12.5 Where the settlement is not approved at the second settlement hearing the claim will no longer continue under the Stage 3 Procedure and the court will give directions. ## Settlement at Stage 3 where the claimant is a child

## 13.1 Paragraphs 13.2 and 13.3 apply where—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 13.1 Paragraphs 13.2 and 13.3 apply where—] (1) the claimant is a child;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 13.1 Paragraphs 13.2 and 13.3 apply where—] (2) there is a settlement after proceedings have started under the Stage 3 Procedure; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 13.1 Paragraphs 13.2 and 13.3 apply where—] (3) an application is made to the court to approve the settlement. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 13.1 Paragraphs 13.2 and 13.3 apply where—] 13.2 Where the settlement is approved at the settlement hearing the court will order the costs to be paid in accordance with rule 45.31(2). [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 13.1 Paragraphs 13.2 and 13.3 apply where—] 13.3 Where the settlement is not approved at the settlement hearing the court will order the claim to proceed to a Stage 3 hearing. ## Adjournment

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > Adjournment] 14.1 Where the court adjourns a settlement hearing or a Stage 3 hearing it may, in its discretion, order the costs to be paid in accordance with rule 45.38. ## Appeals – determination on the papers

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > Appeals – determination on the papers] 15.1 The court will not consider an application to set aside a judgment made after a determination on the papers. The judgment will state the appeal court to which an appeal lies. ## Limitation

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > Limitation] 16.1 Where compliance with the relevant Protocol is not possible before the expiry of a limitation period the claimant may start proceedings in accordance with paragraph 16.2. ## 16.2 The claimant must—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.2 The claimant must—] (1) start proceedings under this Practice Direction; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.2 The claimant must—] (2) state on the claim form that—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.2 The claimant must—] (a) the claim is for damages; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.2 The claimant must—] (b) a stay of proceedings is sought in order to comply with the relevant Protocol. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.2 The claimant must—] 16.3 The claimant must send to the defendant the claim form together with the order imposing the stay. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.2 The claimant must—] 16.4 Where a claim is made under paragraph 16.1 the provisions in this Practice Direction, except paragraphs 1.2, 2.1, 2.2 and 16.1 to 16.6, are disapplied. ## 16.5 Where—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.5 Where—] (1) a stay is granted by the court;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.5 Where—] (2) the parties have complied with the relevant Protocol; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.5 Where—] (3) the claimant wishes to start the Stage 3 Procedure,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.5 Where—] the claimant must make an application to the court to lift the stay and request directions. ## 16.6 Where the court orders that the stay be lifted—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.6 Where the court orders that the stay be lifted—] (1) the provisions of this Practice Direction will apply; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.6 Where the court orders that the stay be lifted—] (2) the claimant must—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.6 Where the court orders that the stay be lifted—] (a) amend the claim form in accordance with paragraph 5.2; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.6 Where the court orders that the stay be lifted—] (b) file the documents in paragraph 6.1. ## 16.7 Where, during Stage 1 or Stage 2 of the relevant Protocol—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.7 Where, during Stage 1 or Stage 2 of the relevant Protocol—] (1) the claim no longer continues under that Protocol; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.7 Where, during Stage 1 or Stage 2 of the relevant Protocol—] (2) the claimant wishes to start proceedings under Part 7,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 16.7 Where, during Stage 1 or Stage 2 of the relevant Protocol—] the claimant must make an application to the court to lift the stay and request directions. ## Modification to the general rules

## 17.1 The claim will not be allocated to a track. Parts 26 to 29 do not apply. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 49F – PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY CLAIMS IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS AND LOW VALUE PERSONAL INJURY (EMPLOYERS’ LIABILITY AND PUBLIC LIABILITY) CLAIMS – STAGE 3 PROCEDURE > 17.1 The claim will not be allocated to a track. Parts 26 to 29 do not apply.] Updated: Sunday, 1 October 2023
